[type]
Lexer

[grammar]
lexer grammar L;
UID   : [a-zA-Z]+ { self.text[0].isupper() }? { print("UID " + self.text, file=self._output) } ;
LID   : [a-zA-Z]+ { self.text[0].islower() }? { print("LID " + self.text, file=self._output) } ;
WS   : [ \n] -> skip ;

[input]
enum ENUM

[output]
LID enum
UID ENUM
[@0,0:3='enum',<2>,1:0]
[@1,5:8='ENUM',<1>,1:5]
[@2,9:8='<EOF>',<-1>,1:9]
